params.name: DEU_R_starmine_fix_02
params.descriptions:
Idea: The two fastest-moving analyst revision signals for DEU equities - short-horizon earnings estimate revision breadth and the StarMine predicted EBITDA surprise - are combined in an equal-weight sector-relative composite. The market systematically under-reacts to analyst revision clusters, so stocks with fresh upward revision momentum and a positive predicted surprise continue to drift upward over the following weeks.

Rationale for data used: predictive_starmine vendor dataset for DEU TOP500 delay-1. mean_estimate_change_pct_f12m_earnings_14d_4 measures the 14-day percentage change breadth of FY1 earnings consensus estimates; predicted_surprise_f12m_ebitda_4 is the StarMine model forecast of the EBITDA surprise versus consensus for the forward twelve months. Both fields carry full ten-year coverage in the backtest window and are MATRIX type requiring no vector aggregation.

Rationale for operators used: ts_mean over 5 days stabilizes each signal against daily noise; rank equalizes scale; add forms the equal-weight composite; the outer group_rank against GICS sector removes sector-level revision waves, isolating stock-specific revision conviction. 7 operators total, within the 12-operator policy.
